# Vitamin D — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What is the role of Vitamin D?", "bones, immunity"),

    ("What is role?", "bones, immunity"),
    ("What is sources/training?", "sunlight, fatty fish"),
    ("What is note?", "rickets if deficient"),
]

    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")

print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
